tables.totals_check: Page 142 (Aichi to Miyagi) printed subtotal 374,981; my sum of the 18 rows as transcribed is 374,981 (agrees, with Kyoto read as 47,924; had Kyoto been 47,934 the sum would be 374,991). Page 143 (Miyazaki to Yamanashi) sums to 206,226; 374,981 + 206,226 = 581,207, agrees with printed total 581,207.
warnings: Kyoto digit in the tens place is hard to read at scan resolution (924 vs 934 vs 994); 47,924 chosen as best reading and it reconciles with the printed subtotal. Other low-contrast digits (Chiba 25,998; Ibaraki 28,096; Kanagawa 23,020; Saga 28,277; Yamanashi 9,108) were checked by the subtotal/total sums, which agree.
